subject: Dueling deals: capacity tiebreak and tranche assignment
messages:
From: Priya Desai <pri.d@summitbridge.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitBridge go-live window and capacity ask

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. SummitBridge is targeting a phased go-live the week of Oct 12. Our platform will see a burst pattern (interactive chat + nightly batch embedding jobs); attached is a traffic forecast and tentative SLA.

Ask: we need confirmation on a dedicated tranche (8x A100 equivalents) for the 6-week ramp and a firm plan for preemption and fallback so our SRE can finalize runbooks. If we can get a prioritized allocation decision by EOD Wed (Aug 2), we can keep the October timeline.

Attachment: summitbridge_go-live_req.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Appreciate any guidance — Priya
--
Priya Desai
Head of Cloud Partnerships, SummitBridge
pri.d@summitbridge.ai

Subject: RE: Capacity for upcoming launch — Velox request

Hi Rishi / Karthik,

Velox is also accelerating their model evaluation and wants to lock a dedicated tranche for Sept-Nov (10x A100 eq) — their traffic shape is more sustained but lower peak. They sent the CSV with per-hour estimates. We recognize SummitBridge has a hard go-live date and appreciate the complexity, but Velox's ARR and committed contract value are material to our Q4 targets.

Attachment: velox_traffic_forecast.csv (CSV)

Can we get clarity on priority rules? Happy to jump on a short call.

Thanks,

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SummitBridge & Velox capacity asks — need tiebreak rubric by EOD

Team,

Looping you in because both deals are asking for overlapping dedicated slices in Sept-Oct. SummitBridge: short, high peak; Velox: longer, steadier commit. We need a quick-but-defensible tiebreak rubric we can apply immediately and communicate to both customers. Constraints:
- Fleet shortfall: ~12 A100-equivalents for core rack availability in early Sept
- Business priority: Velox has a higher committed ARR but SummitBridge is a product launch with potential expansion if we meet the go-live date

Proposed timeline: 1) agree rubric by 15:00 PT; 2) operational tranches locked by 17:00 PT; 3) notify customers by 18:00 PT.

Please reply with a recommended approach (3 bullets max) and whether you can support the timeline.

Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SummitBridge & Velox capacity asks — need tiebreak rubric by EOD

Rishi — quick thoughts:

1) Safety-of-service first: prioritize go-lives with documented runbooks and fallback paths (SummitBridge has a hard date and runbook in the spreadsheet).
2) Revenue-weighted reserve: allocate proportional reserve based on committed ARR and remaining contract term (Velox > SummitBridge on immediate ARR, but SummitBridge has expansion upside tied to meeting SLA).
3) Hybrid tranche split: carve 6 A100-eq to SummitBridge for peak windows (mornings 9-13 PT and evening ramp), and 6 to Velox steady capacity; allow scheduled preemption windows for SummitBridge during low-peak batch periods; ops to automate prefix caching to reduce required A100 equivalents during preemption.

I can support the timeline; Ops will need the final tranche sizes by 16:30.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Director, Customer Success (Dedicated), Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: SummitBridge & Velox capacity asks — need tiebreak rubric by EOD

On Mon, Aug 31, 2026 at 12:02 PM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Rishi — quick thoughts:
>
> 1) Safety-of-service first: prioritize go-lives with documented runbooks and fallback paths (SummitBridge has a hard date and runbook in the spreadsheet).
> 2) Revenue-weighted reserve: allocate proportional reserve based on committed ARR and remaining contract term (Velox > SummitBridge on immediate ARR, but SummitBridge has expansion upside tied to meeting SLA).
> 3) Hybrid tranche split: carve 6 A100-eq to SummitBridge for peak windows (mornings 9-13 PT and evening ramp), and 6 to Velox steady capacity; allow scheduled preemption windows for SummitBridge during low-peak batch periods; ops to automate prefix caching to reduce required A100 equivalents during preemption.

Agree with Ben but flagging two operational caveats:
- Our current scheduler cannot guarantee sub-hour preemption without a short patch; that patch will take ~48 hours to QA. If we promise preemption windows we must either accept higher manual ops overhead or delay commitment to SummitBridge.
- Tranche isolation: carving 6/6 leaves only ~0-4 A100-eq spare capacity for cross-customer failover; recommend a smaller carved reserve of 4 A100-eq as a safety buffer, with conditional overflow to burst pool if monitoring shows <70% utilization for 3 consecutive hours.

Proposal to finalize:
- Immediate: 6 A100-eq reserved to Velox (Sept-Nov commit)
- Conditional: 6 A100-eq logical slice for SummitBridge scheduled by time windows, plus a shared 4 A100-eq buffer for failover
- Ops action: prioritize the preemption patch and automations; if patch not ready by Sept 3, shift SummitBridge to a canary-hosted configuration (hosted + partial dedicated) until we can guarantee isolation.

I can coordinate the patch; need go/no-go by end of day.

Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
VP, Infrastructure & Product Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Desai <pri.d@summitbridge.ai>, Aaron Lim <aaron.l@velox.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Decision: tranche split and next steps (SummitBridge & Velox)

Priya / Aaron — thank you both for the fast turnaround. After weighing runway, ARR, and operational readiness we are executing the following plan for Sept 1 through Oct 15 (trial window):

1) Velox: 6 A100-eq dedicated tranche (steady allocation) — committed Sept 1–Nov 30 per your contract.
2) SummitBridge: 6 A100-eq logical tranche scheduled for peak windows (09:00–13:00 PT & 18:00–22:00 PT) with documented fallback to a hosted canary during unscheduled preemption.
3) Shared buffer: 4 A100-eq cold buffer for cross-customer failover; automatic overflow into burst pool if utilization falls below thresholds.

Operational realities and next steps:
- Karthik: please prioritize the preemption patch; target QA complete by Sept 2 EOD. If the patch fails, we will move SummitBridge to hosted canary + limited dedicated during peak until isolation is safe.
- Ben / Marissa: update runbooks and SLO pages; notify SummitBridge SRE & Velox contacts with explicit preemption windows and escalation path.
- Contracts: Finance to confirm minor SLA amendment on scheduled preemption within 24 hours; I will copy in legal if we need redlines.

Attachments: tranche_rubric_v1.pdf (decision rubric used)

I'll host a 30-minute sync at 16:30 PT to walk through automation steps; calendar invite to follow.

Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
